texts.orig: 4 special note is needed here: this was found to be consistent for a set of branes all grade restricted to one of the window types in 4. On the other hand, if a set of branes grade restricted to different window types were mixed together; so that the entire set was not grade restricted to the same charge window type; then the open Witten indices was found to be inconsistent. Thus it is believed that branes must be restricted in exactly the same way when computing the Witten index; despite multiple ways of charge restriction being valid for a single choice of theta-angle. charge grade
